title: Jawahar Mal Rejects a Cash Settlement and Demands Honor

blocks.text: Episode 158 opens by showing that negotiation alone cannot satisfy Jawahar Mal. Jawahar Mal did not agree to a simple monetary settlement because he is determined to never barter his family's reputation after the murder that had dishonored his house.

His position is framed in terms of lineage, vengeance, and public memory. Since he has already spent heavily on the campaign and risked his standing before allies, he will not accept a compromise that looks like a purchased silence rather than justice.

The page therefore sets up the symbolic terms of settlement that follow on the next readable page. Instead of cash alone, the discussion moves toward a girl in matrimony, lots of jewels and treasures, and formal gestures through which Jawahar Mal can claim that his father's murder had he avenged before the world.
